note: M33 B: the five great powers' paths. The crown's own steps are goals with rewards, checked each month in order. A rival's step comes on its own: once `months` have passed since the last, with `chance` a month; its effects change that realm (army: soldiers to its standing army; treasury: crowns; nets: depth added to its spy networks in the realms named, or everywhere; garrison: men in a town of its own; elves: how Aedirn settles Dol Blathanna). The news reaches Temeria in full where it has eyes in that court (informed), as a rumour elsewhere.

steps.name: The cities in order
steps.text: Set Vizima, Maribor, Gors Velen, Ellander and White Bridge in order (the Dawn).

steps.name: Prince of Sodden
steps.text: Bring Sodden under the crown's protection or make it a vassal.

steps.name: Protector of Brugge
steps.text: Bring Brugge under the crown's protection or make it a vassal.

steps.name: Protector of Mahakam
steps.text: Offer the dwarves of Mahakam the crown's protection, and have them take it.

steps.name: An understanding with Cintra
steps.text: Come to terms with Queen Calanthe: any treaty with Cintra, or her trust at 60 or more.

steps.name: Dijkstra's networks
steps.text: Dijkstra's agents are in every capital of the North.

steps.name: Novigrad brought to heel
steps.text: Novigrad and the Hierarch bend the knee to Tretogor.

steps.name: The treasury filled
steps.text: Redania's treasury is full, and its tax farmers are feared.

steps.name: A sorceress at court
steps.text: Philippa Eilhart sits at Vizimir's right hand.

steps.name: The Blue Mountains cleared
steps.text: Henselt's men root the Scoia'tael out of the Blue Mountains, cave by cave.

steps.name: The army drilled
steps.text: Kaedwen's levies drill all winter; they march like regulars now.

steps.name: Ban Ard bound to the crown
steps.text: The mages of Ban Ard swear to serve the crown in war.

steps.name: The marches claimed
steps.text: Henselt presses his claim on Aedirn's border marches, and garrisons them.

aedirn.name: The Valley and the Mines
aedirn.war: Depends on the elves of Dol Blathanna, who may side with the Empire.

steps.name: Dol Blathanna settled
steps.text: Demavend settles the elves of Dol Blathanna

steps.name: Vengerberg and the Pontar fortified
steps.text: New walls go up at Vengerberg and along the Pontar.

steps.name: The mines of Upper Aedirn
steps.text: The mines of Upper Aedirn are opened, and silver comes down the valleys.

steps.name: The governors bound
steps.text: Emhyr binds the provincial governors to him with hostages and gold.

steps.name: Toussaint made sure
steps.text: Toussaint swears loyalty again, with its duchess's hand on the Emperor's banner.

steps.name: Agents deep in Cintra
steps.text: Imperial agents are in Calanthe's own household.

steps.name: The host at the Yaruga
steps.text: The Emperor's host masses on the Yaruga's southern bank.
